author: salivan
text: yes KIMA it's a nice diamond to shake out retailers. always trade the extreme then you will trade where others close their position and open opposite (in fact just to make IT's LQ), for training this, start looking on your charts in the form of 1 min chart(assume all your chart are 1 min chart ). and always ask your self if you've had a billion of dollar how you could be the only one that short/buy. this will solve the puzzle of price reading for you. hope it helps you regards Salivan
